name: How much does it cost to clear a clogged drain?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to clear a clogged drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to clear a clogged drain can vary depending on the severity and location of the clog. Simple clogs in an accessible sink or shower drain might be less expensive than more complex blockages located deeper in the main sewer line. Factors like the time of day (emergency services often cost more), the type of equipment needed (e.g., snake vs. hydro-jetting), and diagnostic time can also influence the final price. Alpha-Plumbing Services provides upfront estimates after assessing the issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost varies based on clog severity, location, and the equipment needed. Alpha-Plumbing Services provides upfront estimates.
